in_arabic.name: هورية
in_arabic.long_meaning: الْحُورِيَّةُ: أُنثى الحُورِ، فَتياتَ قُدسٍ، قِصارَ الأَعيُنِ، تَحتَضنُها الأَنامُ، يَحتَضنُها العَزِيزُ، مَلكَ العِزِّ، أَبَداً مَعَ أَبَدٍ، هُناكَ مُتَبَدِّلَةَ الأَزِمَّةِ، عَلى رَوعَةٍ مِنَ العِزِّ، وَإِنَّهُمُ عَلى عِزٍّ مِنَ اللَهِ يَسْتَمِعُونَ

in_urdu.name: ہوریہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ہوریہ (حوریہ): اس کا مطلب ہے پاک اور پاکیزہ لڑکی، جو اللہ کے قربت میں رہتی ہے۔ اس کے معنی پاکیزگی اور نیکی کے بھی ہیں۔ اس نام کے ذریعے اللہ نے مسلمانوں کے لئے جنت کا وعدہ کیا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हुरीया
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुरीया (हुरीया): यह नाम अरबी भाषा से आया है, जिसका अर्थ है एक पवित्र और पवित्र लड़की, जो अल्लाह के निकट होती है। इस नाम के माध्यम से अल्लाह ने मुसलमानों को जन्नत का वादा किया है।

in_pashto.name: هوریا
in_pashto.long_meaning: هوریا (هوریا): دا معنی یوځئی پاکه او پاکیزه لورګۍ ده، چې پر الله کې قربت کوي. په دې نوم کې د پاکیزگی او نیکمرغۍ هم معنی دی. د هوریا نوم په لامل الله مسلمانو ته جنات کا وعدہ کړی دی.

in_english.name: Hooriyah
in_english.meaning: A heavenly, virtuous and pure maiden, a sign of paradise
in_english.long_meaning: Hooriyah (Hooriyah): This name refers to a heavenly, virtuous, and pure maiden, a sign of paradise. It is derived from the Arabic root H-R-Y, meaning to be virtuous, pure, and beautiful. The name is mentioned in the Quran as a reward for the righteous, signifying a state of spiritual excellence and closeness to God.

It is a name that embodies the beauty, grace, and features of the houris (female companions) in Paradise. Hooriyah is a name that represents the hope and longing for eternal paradise and the physical and emotional pleasures that it holds. This name is also a reminder of the moral and ethical virtues that Muslims should uphold in their daily lives in order to earn a place in Paradise.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Hooriyah holds an immense spiritual significance for Muslims as it symbolizes the promise of eternal beauty, pleasure, and companionship in Paradise. It is a reminder of Allah's infinite mercy and generosity towards those who have led a virtuous and righteous life. Hooriyah also represents the concept of reward in Islam, emphasizing that good deeds and obedience to Allah's commandments will lead to eternal happiness and satisfaction. Additionally, the name Hooriyah serves as a source of inspiration and motivation for Muslims to strive towards marrying the beautiful names and attributes of Allah and living a virtuous life in accordance with His teachings.
